decision.summary: NO_ACTION: the 77k-78k battlefield is still unresolved, and the 08:00 board does not yet show a clean confirmed rebound or breakdown.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Account state is coherent and shows no open positions, so there is nothing to close or reduce and the daily slots remain free. The latest Beecthor summary still leaves BTC in a 50/50 state around the decisive 77k-78k zone: if that support holds with clearer structure, a rebound toward 82k is possible; if it fails and flips to resistance, the bearish path toward 68k gains priority. At 08:00 UTC Binance spot is about 78,187, only marginally above the 06:00 level and still too close to the same support battlefield. The bearish candidate `will-bitcoin-dip-to-77k-on-may-17` Yes is only about 0.335 and still lacks breakdown confirmation. The nearest upside candidate `will-bitcoin-reach-79k-on-may-17` Yes is about 0.485, but the latest Beecthor update explicitly says he does not want longs by inertia and would only consider them after a clearer bullish structure and recovery of the lost area. The 08:00 strategic bonus does not override that lack of confirmation, so the playbook still favors waiting.
